spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B 'Control Room' - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Mode A 'Tetris' Grid - asymmetrical layouts gap-8 to gap-12
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing philosophy (p-8 to p-12 for containers)
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Subtle roundness, max 12px for cards, max 24px for chat bubbles

components.buttons: Rounded-lg or rounded-full, distinct hover states. MUST NOT use default blue.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-[#F3F0EB]), 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), no heavy dropshadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components.chat_ui: Hybrid input (text + quick replies). User bubbles: rounded-l-2xl rounded-tr-2xl bg-[#E8E3DA] text-[#1A251F]. AI bubbles: rounded-r-2xl rounded-tl-2xl bg-[#2C4C3B] text-white.
components.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism over hero images (bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-stone-200/50)
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but strip default 'Vercel' look. Inputs use bg-white border-stone-200 focus:ring-[#2C4C3B]

motion.chat_bubbles: framer-motion entrance: initial={opacity: 0, y: 10} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}

hero_background.description: Abstract warm sand texture, use for soft backgrounds with low opacity

clinic_spa_interior.description: Warm, sunny spa interior for business profile or marketing section

business_owner.description: Business owner portrait for testimonials or onboarding preview

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses backdrop-blur or gradient overlay.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='chat-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) color palette. Do NOT use default blue or purple colors.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Figtree' for body fonts.
For the AI Chatbot interface, prioritize organic, rounded shapes and a calm aesthetic instead of a 'tech/neon' look.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and links have data-testid attributes for testing.
Dashboard should be dense but approachable (Control Room grid style), utilizing muted clay and stone colors.
